name: DrugShortageSupplyRiskMonitor
tagline: See every SKU's stock cover, supply gap and single-source API exposure – and never miss a regulator shortage notification.
description: A complete pharmaceutical supply-continuity app for Power Apps and Power Pages: weeks of cover per SKU and market against the safety-stock target, projected stock-outs and supply gaps before the next receipt, a 0–100 risk score, single-source API and supplier concentration, an enforced risk workflow from at risk to resolved, and a per-market authority notification tracker (FDA 506C, EU Art. 23a and more, configurable).
features: 10 KPI tiles and criticality × cover heat map
Single-source API detection pooled across SKUs
Per-market notification rules with notify-by and overdue
Workflow rules: owner, mitigation plan, notification, recovery date, closure rationale
Bulk owner assignment, flag at risk, export
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control DrugShortageSupplyRiskMonitorPortal, shared src/app)
